## Bernstein: SpaceX AI ambitions hinge on Starship achieving full reusability

Full reusability is the prerequisite for launch economics that underpin SpaceX's AI-era ambitions — failure or delay on this milestone could materially reset both the timeline and the valuation basis for SPCX's infrastructure story.

- Bernstein identifies full Starship reusability as 'absolutely central' to SPCX's AI infrastructure aspirations.
- An upcoming Starship test is framed as a pivotal commercial and technical gating event.
